fato_historico: 1962: Major Rudolf Anderson of the United States Air Force becomes the only direct human casualty of the Cuban Missile Crisis when his U-2 reconnaissance airplane is shot down over Cuba by a Soviet-supplied surface-to-air missile.

Consider letting go of old anxieties, trusting that your resilience will guide you through any unexpected challenges that arise.
frase_do_dia: Even amidst the deepest clouds, your inner light remains a constant guiding beacon.
